name.value: Devil's Elbow Ale and Smoke House

description.value: Devil's Elbow Smoke & Ale House is a BBQ-focused bar and restaurant that opened in 2014, built around slow-smoked meats sourced locally from Jackson's Butcher in Kitsilano and housemade sauces paired with BC craft beer on tap. Located steps from a SkyTrain station in downtown Vancouver, it offers a lively atmosphere with a dedicated Whiskey Room for private events. A touring cyclist rolling into the city will find a full all-day food menu, delivery via DoorDash, and an extensive craft beer and whiskey selection.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address (562 Beatty St, V6B 2L3), phone (604-559-0611), and URL. Menu pages explicitly mark vegetarian (V) and gluten-friendly (GF) items throughout, and the private events page confirms washrooms exist on premises ('two private washrooms' in the Whiskey Room). No bike-specific amenities (racks, parking, pump, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Devil's Elbow Ale and Smoke House' but website uses 'Devils Elbow Ale & Smokehouse' and 'Devil's Elbow Smoke & Ale House' interchangeably — minor naming inconsistency.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active food-and-drink business at a confirmed address near a SkyTrain station, but no bike parking or visibility is confirmed — the single required criterion most relevant to WWC inclusion for a Food & Drink listing. A site visit or staff inquiry to confirm a bike rack or patio sightline would resolve this.
